_comment: MIO-TCD class ID (0-10, see configs/miotcd.yaml) -> FHWA class or sub-classifier routing. Integer values are final FHWA classes (1-13). 'drop' means exclude from counts (non-vehicle). 'axle_articulated' routes to stage-2 axle sub-classifier for Classes 8/9/10. 'axle_single_unit' routes to stage-2 axle sub-classifier for Classes 5/6/7.
